original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Exact formal F2[D16] word synthesis on two arbitrary dirty scalar registers. G=<r,s | r^8=s^2=1, srs=r^-1>; paid labels x=s and y=rs; target diag([r^4],[r^4]); every rank-one idempotent N in M2(F2) is allowed.
scope_change_reason: Change the address group and central-target relation depth from the local two-register D8 result: the target central involution r^4 has shortest paid label word length 8 per target. Keep two registers. The live D8 third-register claim #1738 changes register count while retaining D8; this result fixes two registers and changes the group relation and target.
bottleneck_link: This is a deliberately optimistic scalar-call mechanism screen in a nonabelian address model; any saving would still require an actual supplier mapping. The exact minimum shows no saving in this bounded D16 mechanism.
stop_rule: Complete identity radius 7 and target radius 8 or stop at 4,000,000 states per ball. Report only complete layers if capped. A candidate is useful only if its exact paid call count is at most 15.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json; independently implemented tuple-state group-algebra replay in verify.py; all 16 direct-call omissions and label/endpoint mutations rejected.
